name: ScholarMarket
tagline: Students bet crypto on improving their own grades, with a model predicting outcomes.
problem: Students lose motivation to distractions, including gambling-style apps.
solution: Smart contracts let students stake on their academic performance, a grade-prediction model sets odds, and universities could fund 'probabilistic scholarships'.
demo_moment: Team-described: place a bet on your next grade and track it.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “ETHGlobal: Ethereum's Infinite Garden” among 261 submissions.
Turns a distraction (betting) into a motivator.

lessons: Flipping a bad habit into a tool is memorable, but expect ethics questions.
